name: Spout2 Layout Feed
description: Plays levels in Layout Mode on your screen while OBS receives the normal, fully decorated level through Spout2.

enabled.name: Enable Spout2 sender
enabled.description: Sends the normal game picture (menus, levels, shaders, all 2.2 effects) to OBS. The frame is shared GPU-to-GPU when the driver supports it.

capture-cursor.name: Capture cursor
capture-cursor.description: Draws the Windows cursor into the Spout2 feed only.

layout-enabled.name: Enable Layout Mode
layout-enabled.description: Redraws the level on your screen without decoration, colors and shaders. The Spout2 feed always shows the normal level. The level itself is never modified, so triggers, shaders and camera effects keep working.

layout-recolor-objects.name: Remove object colors
layout-recolor-objects.description: Draws gameplay objects with the fixed colors below instead of their color channels, pulses and HSV.

layout-force-opacity.name: Show invisible objects
layout-force-opacity.description: Ignores alpha triggers and fades, like Layout Mode with alpha triggers removed.

layout-normal-blending.name: Disable additive blending
layout-normal-blending.description: Draws objects on blending color channels with normal blending so they stay visible.

layout-disable-shaders.name: Disable shaders
layout-disable-shaders.description: Skips 2.2 shader triggers (glitch, chromatic, blur, shockwave, ...) on your screen only.

debug-logging.name: Debug logging
debug-logging.description: Writes detailed diagnostics to the Geode log: OpenGL driver info, Spout2 share mode, per-level object statistics, OpenGL errors and periodic CPU/GPU timings.

debug-gpu-timers.name: Measure GPU time
debug-gpu-timers.description: Uses asynchronous OpenGL timer queries; they never stall the frame.
